age.evidence: Male Wistar rats (Charles River), ranging from 350 to 500 g

sex.evidence: Male Wistar rats (Charles River), ranging from 350 to 500 g

dosing.evidence: 4-Acetoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine fumarate (4-AcO-DMT)... was dissolved in 0.9 % sodium chloride (saline) and administered intraperitoneally (i.p.)... four drug-environment and four saline-environment conditioning sessions over eight consecutive days.

assays.assay_description: Unbiased, unforced, fully counterbalanced CPP in two wooden compartments (white/wire mesh vs black/Plexiglas with acetic acid odor) separated by a neutral gray area. Conditioning sessions 40 min; test 10 min of free exploration. Three procedures: B (drug vs saline counterbalanced over 8 days), D (drug vs non-paired, 4 sessions), W (saline 24h post-drug vs non-paired, 4 sessions).

setup_habituation.evidence: The pre-exposure phase involved a single 20-minute session in separate wooden boxes (41 × 41 × 38 cm) painted gray with a gray floor

setup_restrain.evidence: could explore both environments freely for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: free access to food... during the entire experiment; food not present in the testing apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: free access to... water during the entire experiment; water not present in the testing apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Testing was performed in a drug-free state, at least 2 days after the final conditioning session

outcomes.summary: In the standard counterbalanced procedure (B), 4 mg/kg 4-AcO-DMT induced place aversion relative to saline, while 2 and 10 mg/kg had no effect. In the acute-only procedure (D), 2 mg/kg induced place preference vs a non-paired compartment, while 4 and 10 mg/kg had no effect. In the withdrawal-only procedure (W), the 24-h aftereffect at 2 and 4 mg/kg produced place preference, while 10 mg/kg had no effect.
outcomes.evidence: 4-AcO-DMT (4 mg/kg) induced aversion (*p < 0.05)... 4-AcO-DMT (2 mg/kg) induced reward (*p < 0.05)... Withdrawal from 4-AcO-DMT (2 and 4 mg/kg) induced reward (*p < 0.05)

B1_num_measures.evidence: The preference index for each animal was calculated by subtracting the time spent in the saline-paired environment from the time spent in the drug-paired environment

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: explore both environments freely for 10 min (single total preference index reported)

B6_cognitive.evidence: conditioned place preference paradigm is a well-established model utilized to investigate the role of context associations in reward-related behaviors

B8_multivariate.evidence: one-way ANOVA with post hoc Tukey

E1_environment_type.evidence: Conditioning occurred in one of two distinct wooden environments (41 × 41 × 38 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: open wooden compartments with wire mesh or Plexiglas floor; no enclosed refuge

E3_bedding.evidence: wire mesh floor... smooth Plexiglas floor

E6_spatial.evidence: two distinct wooden environments... neutral gray area (41 × 10 cm) that separated the two wooden compartments

E7_social_context.evidence: each rat was placed in the neutral gray area... and could explore both environments freely

E8_food_water.evidence: Food/water in home cage only, not in CPP apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: Test session of 10 min; pre-exposure had no behavioral data collection (unbiased, devoid of any test session before conditioning)

D2_session_duration.evidence: explore both environments freely for 10 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Testing was performed... at least 2 days after the final conditioning session (single test day; no pre-conditioning test)

D4_baseline.evidence: unbiased, unforced, fully counterbalanced, and devoid of any test session before conditioning

D5_followup.evidence: Testing was performed in a drug-free state, at least 2 days after the final conditioning session

judge_notes: Single behavioural assay: CPP. Procedures B/D/W are variants of the same paradigm (same apparatus, same measured outcome — preference index) under different conditioning schedules, so collapsed into one assay per rubric.
Excluded Western blot of VTA BDNF (ex vivo molecular endpoint — not a behavioural assay).

D4 (baseline) scored No: paper explicitly states the design was 'devoid of any test session before conditioning'; the 20-min pre-exposure was in a separate gray box with no data reported, so it is habituation, not a recorded baseline. This overrides GLM's Yes.
D1 scored Single session and D3 scored 1 day: only the post-conditioning test trial yielded recorded preference data.
C2 setup_habituation scored Yes based on the explicit 20-min pre-exposure session in gray boxes (apparatus exposure prior to test).

time_to_assay set to short_term_1to7d (≥2 days after last drug dose); not 'multiple' because the rubric's 'multiple' applies to the same assay performed at ≥2 distinct timepoints relative to dosing — here all CPP tests were ≥48 h post-last-injection.
